pages.text: The $(item)Structure Scanner$() captures builds as blueprints. Right-click two corner blocks to define the box, hold a $(item)Blank Blueprint Disc$() in your offhand, then right-click the air to scan.$(br2)The result is a written $(item)Blueprint Disc$() — portable, tradeable, and reusable.

pages.title: Discs
pages.text: Shift+Right Click a written disc to $(l)lock$() it against overwriting. Load it into a Tier 3+ printer to print the structure. The print area must be pre-cleared — the printer never replaces existing blocks.$(br2)Admins can import WorldEdit .schem and Create .nbt files with $(l)/mc3dprint import$().
